Mid-Late December 2023 (First) |virtual_item = {{Color|Other|Umbra}} skin for [[Commander]] |toy_type = Plushie }} ==Description== The '''Umbra Mini Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers [[The Umbra]] enemy. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Umbra}} skin for the [[Commander]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards. The crown is detachable. It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton, it is 6.7 inches long, 10.6 inches tall (8 inches without crown) and 4.7 inches wide, or 17.018 centimetres long, 26.924 centimetres tall (20.32 centimetres without crown) and 11.938 centimetres wide. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Umbra Mini Plush'''. ==Official Description== *'''Online (Fourth)''' *:The shadow rises again. With piercing yellow eyes and bow at the ready, this Umbra Mini Plush is the ultimate addition to your Tower Defense collection. This plush does not include an in-game reward. *'''Online (Third)''' *:The shadow rises again. With piercing yellow eyes and bow at the ready, this Umbra Mini Plush is the ultimate addition to your Tower Defense collection. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward. *'''Online (Second)''' *:Totality approaches...With piercing yellow eyes and bow at the ready, this Umbra Mini Plush is the ultimate addition to your Tower Defense collection. *'''Online (First)''' *:With piercing yellow eyes and a removable arrow, this Umbra Plush is the ultimate edition to your Tower Defense collection. ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Umbra Mini Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $26.99. Previously, it had a cost of $24.99. When first sold, it had a cost of $21.99. The '''Umbra Mini Plush''' was also put on sale on the 24th of November 2023 at a discounted price of $17.59 without shipping or tax for Black Friday. Oddly, it was discounted to $21.24 for the Black Friday 2024 Sale, despite being offsale. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Showcase}} UmbraPlushShowcase1.png UmbraPlushShowcase2.png UmbraPlushShowcase3.png UmbraPlushShowcase4.png UmbraPlushShowcase5.png UmbraPlushShowcase6.png UmbraPlushShowcase7.png UmbraPlushShowcase8.png UmbraPlushShowcase9.png UmbraPlushShowcase10.png UmbraPlushShowcase11.png UmbraPlushShowcase12.png UmbraPlushShowcase13.png UmbraPlushShowcase14.png UmbraPlushShowcase15.png UmbraPlushShowcase16.png UmbraPlushShowcase17.png UmbraPlushShowcase18.png UmbraPlushShowcase19.png UmbraMiniPlush Banner Mobile-v2.jpg UmbraMiniPlush Banner-v2.jpg Mini Umbra Banner.webp }} {{ToyNavBox}} [[Category:Plushies]]
